categories.name: Analytic Geometry
categories.description: Points, lines and conic sections studied with coordinates: distances, slopes, intersections and equations of curves.

categories.name: Algebra
categories.description: Equations, polynomials, systems of equations, exponents, radicals and logarithms.

categories.name: Trigonometry
categories.description: Angles, triangles and periodic functions: right-triangle ratios, the laws of sines and cosines, identities and equations.

categories.name: Calculus
categories.description: Derivatives, tangent lines, critical points and integrals for analysing rates of change and areas.

categories.name: Statistics & Probability
categories.description: Describing data and quantifying uncertainty: averages, spread, normal and binomial distributions, confidence intervals.

categories.name: Combinatorics
categories.description: Systematic counting: factorials, arrangements, selections, the binomial theorem and inclusion–exclusion.

categories.name: Engineering Mathematics
categories.description: Complex numbers, matrices and the numerical methods engineers use for roots, derivatives and integrals.

categories.name: Physics
categories.description: Motion, forces, energy, circuits and waves: kinematics, projectiles, Newton's second law, Ohm's law and resistor networks, each with its assumptions stated.
